set.q:
다음 문장에서 though는 그대로 둘 때, 어법상 불필요한 단어는?
Though the road was long, but we enjoyed the walk.
o: Though
but
road
enjoyed
set.why: though와 but은 함께 쓰지 않아요. 접속사 though가 있으므로 but을 빼야 해요.

patches.why: Identity field q changed: disambiguates that though is kept.

set.q: 다음 중 'no matter wh-'로 바꿔 쓸 수 없는 복합관계사절이 있는 문장은?
o: Whatever she cooks, it tastes great.
Whoever calls, I will not answer.
Wherever he goes, he takes a book.
Whatever she cooks tastes great.
set.why: 'Whatever she cooks tastes great.'의 whatever절은 주어 역할을 하는 명사절이라 no matter what으로 바꿀 수 없어요. 나머지는 양보의 부사절이에요.

patches.why: Identity field q changed: stem wording matches all options.

set.q:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
She was very tired. She finished the race.
o: Because she was very tired, she finished the race.
Unless she was very tired, she finished the race.
So that she was very tired, she finished the race.
Although she was very tired, she finished the race.
set.why: 피곤했다는 사실과 경주를 끝냈다는 내용이 대조되므로 although가 알맞아요.

patches.why: Identity field q/o changed: original 'cold/played outside' allowed a causal reading with because.

set.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 바르게 고친 것은?
However I try hard, I cannot lift this rock.
o: However I try → Whatever I try
cannot lift → cannot lifting
this rock → these rock
However I try hard → However hard I try
set.why: '아무리 열심히 해도'는 however 바로 뒤에 hard를 붙인 However hard I try 어순이에요.

patches.why: Identity field o changed: distractor lengths balanced.

set.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 바르게 고친 것은?
No matter what do you choose, I will respect it.
o: what do you choose → what you choose
I will respect → I will respects
No matter what → No matters what
respect it → respecting it
set.why: no matter what절 안에서는 의문문이 아닌 평서문 어순(you choose)을 써요.
